long_biography.plain_text:
Dubens began as an entrepreneur in his early twenties, acquiring, growing and selling small consumer businesses before moving into public-market technology and communications. He later built and sold Pipex Communications and 365 Media, learning first-hand how difficult it could be for founders to find patient financial backing.

He created Oakley Capital in 2002 to provide that support. The firm became a pan-European private-equity investor focused on technology, consumer, education and business services, and Dubens remains its managing partner and controlling shareholder. Although he now allocates capital and advises management teams, Founder best describes his relationship to the wealth platform because Oakley itself is the business he created and still leads.
